dedupe_keys.name: merit drainattr baseline drainage attributes for the global 90 m drainage network

description: Lulu Jiang and colleagues publish MERIT-DrainAttr, four precomputed drainage attributes for the global 90 m MERIT Hydro network. Zenodo serves per-region raster packages under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. The layers give downstream and upstream flow length, Strahler stream order and upstream drainage area for about 22.2 billion land pixels across 65 hydrological regions. A flood, reservoir or transport-exposure model can use these fields to define catchments, channel order or routing distance without recomputing them. The related MERIT-FlowTopo deposit holds traversal structures, while this record contains ready-to-use attributes. A limitation is that the underlying MERIT Hydro elevation, direction and accumulation grids are not redistributed here and retain their own terms. Derived fields inherit errors and resolution limits from that base. No regional ZIP was downloaded, and grid alignment or numerical accuracy was not independently checked.
